multi_index.description: tuple of array_like A tuple of integer arrays, one array for each dimension.

dims.description: tuple of ints The shape of array into which the indices from ``multi_index`` apply.

mode.description: {'raise', 'wrap', 'clip'}, optional Specifies how out-of-bounds indices are handled. Can specify either one mode or a tuple of modes, one mode per index.
constraints: mode must be one of raise, wrap, clip

order.description: {'C', 'F'}, optional Determines whether the multi-index should be viewed as indexing in row-major (C-style) or column-major (Fortran-style) order.

output.description: ------- ndarray An array of indices into the flattened version of an array of dimensions ``dims``.
